MLA Standard: MLA.CPP.PATH.1 | CPALMS/FDOE Career and Education Planning 03.01

A student is completing Options After High School. Review the evidence table and choose the response that best demonstrates step selection for options after high school.

Item 1 planning evidence
Assessment focusoptions after high school
Evidence sourcepathway pros and cons chart
Required reasoningstep selection aligned to MLA.CPP.PATH.1 | CPALMS/FDOE Career and Education Planning 03.01
Student productlesson response with a clear evidence-based decision

Which response is the strongest standards-aligned answer?

correctfeedback.text: Correct. The response connects standards, evidence, and career-planning reasoning.

partiallycorrectfeedback.text: Review whether the answer both uses evidence and explains the planning decision.

incorrectfeedback.text: Revisit the standard, locate the relevant evidence in the visual, and explain how the evidence supports the decision.

answer.text: Choose the option that feels most interesting and write a short personal preference statement without checking the pathway pros and cons chart.

feedback.text: This is not sufficient. Personal preference can start the thinking, but the standard requires evidence. Revisit the pathway pros and cons chart and explain how the evidence supports the choice.

answer.text: Complete the next planning step shown by the pathway pros and cons chart: name the evidence, make the decision, and check that the decision matches MLA.CPP.PATH.1 | CPALMS/FDOE Career and Education Planning 03.01.

feedback.text: Correct. This answer uses the required visual evidence, explains the reasoning, and ties the decision directly to MLA.CPP.PATH.1 | CPALMS/FDOE Career and Education Planning 03.01; it also uses lesson evidence before naming the next step.

answer.text: Copy one detail from the lesson and stop once the detail matches one word in the question.

feedback.text: This shows partial recall but not mastery. A standards-aligned response must connect evidence to reasoning, not only repeat one detail.

answer.text: Rank every possible career or pathway equally so the response avoids making a supported decision.

feedback.text: This avoids the decision task. Use the evidence to compare options, state the strongest fit, and explain the tradeoff clearly.
